Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.apikey

Class CreateApiKeyService

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.apikey.CreateApiKeyService
All Implemented Interfaces:
CreateApiKeyUseCase
@Service public class CreateApiKeyService extends Object implements CreateApiKeyUseCase
Default CreateApiKeyUseCase implementation.

Pipeline:

  1. Generate (clientId, cleartext) via ApiKeyGenerator.
  2. BCrypt-hash the cleartext via ApiKeyHasher.
  3. Persist a fresh ApiKey aggregate carrying only the hash.
  4. Return the cleartext in the result so the REST adapter can surface it once.

Label length is enforced by the domain (the ApiKey canonical constructor rejects labels longer than 128 chars with a field-label ValidationException); the REST DTO also adds a @Size(max = 128) guard as defense in depth.

The cleartext API key is never logged. The hash never leaves the service.
